The $\texttt{deep\_tensor}$ package contains a [PyTorch](https://pytorch.org) implementation of the deep inverse Rosenblatt transport (DIRT) algorithm introduced by @Cui2022.

:::{.callout-warning}
This package is currently in a developmental state. Some parts of the API may change without warning in future releases.
:::

# Installation

$\texttt{deep\_tensor}$ can be installed using pip:

::: {#cb70920f .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
pip install deep-tensor-py
```
:::


The package can then be imported using

::: {#f40605c9 .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import deep_tensor as dt
```
:::


# Getting Started

Check out the [examples page](/examples/index.qmd) and [API reference](/reference/index.qmd) for help getting started with $\texttt{deep\_tensor}$.
